errors.evidence: The figure contains TWO pie charts (AttentionInfluence and FineWeb-Edu Classifier), not just one. The description only describes the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart and completely ignores the AttentionInfluence chart.

According to the reference, the FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart has 6 inner slices and 15 outer slices (21 total), but the AttentionInfluence chart has 6 inner and 15 outer slices as well. The description conflates details from both charts.
According to the reference, Health & Medicine in the FineWeb-Edu Classifier is 19%, not 22%. The 22% figure belongs to the AttentionInfluence chart.
The reference states Historical review in FineWeb-Edu Classifier is 12%, not a range of 7-12%. The 7% figure belongs to the AttentionInfluence chart.
According to the reference, Society & culture in FineWeb-Edu Classifier is 5%, not 10%. The 10% figure belongs to AttentionInfluence.
According to the reference, Animal & Plant in FineWeb-Edu Classifier is 12%, not 12-13%. The 13% figure may belong to AttentionInfluence.
According to the reference, Tech & Engineering in FineWeb-Edu Classifier is 8%. The 12% figure belongs to AttentionInfluence.
According to the reference, 'Fin & Law' is a category in AttentionInfluence (3%), not in FineWeb-Edu Classifier. The FineWeb-Edu Classifier does not have a 'Fin & Law' or 'Fin & Engineer' category.
According to the reference, 'Policy' (1%) is a sub-category of the AttentionInfluence chart, not FineWeb-Edu Classifier.
The description completely omits the AttentionInfluence pie chart, which is the left chart described in the reference. The figure contains two charts side by side.

The reference describes each pie chart as having inner slices (main categories) and outer slices (sub-categories) in a nested/donut structure. The machine description does not mention this inner/outer ring structure.
